title: Nak Lose Fat, Tak Payah Stop Makan Nasi!
NAK LOSE
FAT?
slides.small: Here’s what to focus on instead.

slides.title: MOTIVATION **SAHAJA** TAK CUKUP.
body: Ramai orang start diet dengan semangat.
slides.after: Tapi bila kerja busy, Raya datang, routine terus lari.
slides.takeaway: You need habits that **survive real life.**

slides.title: FAHAM **CALORIES**
body: Understand how much food your body needs.
You don’t need to blindly cut out all the foods you love.

slides.title: PROTEIN + **FIBER**
body: Focus on balanced meals with enough protein and fiber.

slides.title: BUILD **REALISTIC** HABITS
body: Kerja busy? Family dinner? Makan luar?
Your eating habits need to fit your **actual life.**

slides.title: ADA **BACKUP** PLAN
body: Bila routine lari, you need simple habits to fall back on.
slides.takeaway: Don’t let one difficult day turn into **giving up completely.**

title: ENJOY YOUR FOOD.
**BUILD CONSISTENCY.**
body: Sustainable fat loss works better with habits you can maintain.
You can enjoy your favourite foods while working towards your goals.
